Name: Cook For Your Loved Ones
Author: Marigold9198
Description:
Ever went to visit Evelyn and thought 'I wish I could make you something yummy?' or went to Sebastian's and thought 'you could really use some lunch?
Now you can provide that!
Reach 8 hearts with a villager, and you unlock the ability to cook their favourite meals, in their own homes.
Click on the stove to start the interaction. Remember to bring your own ingredients!

You have to know the dish recipe, and have discovered what the villager likes before you're able to cook for them.

The dish you cook takes up one of the two weekly gifts you're able to give out. You can't cook for them again that week if you reached the limit :)

[img width=354]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54805/54805-1793313855-856976739.png[/img]    [img width=286]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54805/54805-1793313875-797309878.png[/img]

Each loved item has new dialogue, and the romancable characters have different dialogue depending on whether you are dating them or not.

Currently Leah, Elliot, Clint, Gus, Willy, Krobus, and Linus can't be cooked for, as there isn't a kitchen in their living space... If there is interest I will add that in an update :)
